title: Prescription Acceptance Standard for Northgate Optical Eyewear
content:
**1. Age of the prescription.** A Northgate Optical job is ordered only when the order is placed no later than the lens design's prescription age limit, in calendar months, after the prescription's issue date. Calendar months are added to the issue date and, when the resulting month has no such day, the boundary falls on that month's last day. An order placed on the boundary day itself is accepted. The issue date relied on is the prescription issue date in the system record of that eyewear job.

**2. Power range and fitting height.** The prescription's sphere, cylinder and add powers must be within the design's highest sphere, cylinder and add powers, and the frame's fitting height must be at least the design's smallest fitting height. A prescription outside those limits is ordered in a design that accepts it.

**3. Patients under 18.** Where the design requires impact resistance for minors — every design does — eyewear for a patient under 18 is made only in polycarbonate or Trivex.

**4. Verification.** The optical counter verifies the prescription with the prescribing office before the job is submitted to the lab. A prescription read to member services over the phone is never entered by member services.

## Boundary cases for clause 1 (hypothetical dates)

| Lens design's limit | Prescription issued | Boundary day | Order placed on the boundary day | Order placed the next day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 24 months | 15 March 2024 | 15 March 2026 | accepted | not accepted |
| 12 months | 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2025 (February 2025 has no 29th) | accepted | not accepted (1 March 2025) |
| 24 months | 31 August 2024 | 31 August 2026 | accepted | not accepted |

## Points of judgement

- *Which prescription date is used?* The issue date shown for the prescription on the eyewear job — not the date of the eye examination as recalled by the caller.
- *Whose limit is applied?* The prescription age limit of the lens design ordered on the job.
- *Can member services key in a prescription a caller reads out?* No. Prescriptions are verified by the optical counter with the prescribing office.
